text.description_html:
Don-Jo NLP-106-630, 6 Inch Stainless Narrow Latch Guard Plate

This stainless steel narrow security door latch protector is 6" high and designed specifically for outswing doors (door opens out of the room or building) that require a very narrow plate (only 1-1/2" wide). For use with key-in knobs / levers (door knobs or levers that use a key to unlock).

Protect your commercial hollow metal entry doors from tampering and latch prying with this stainless steel 6" security latch protector plate. No special tools required for installation.

Also available: Taller 10" Narrow Door Latch Guard for use with mortise locks.

The mounting studs are concealed welded to the back side of the security plate leaving no visible point of attack from the outside. Packaged with mounting hardware.

Non-Handed, reversible for left or right hand outswinging doors. Fits doors with standard 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" backset.

Specifications for the Don-Jo NLP-106-630 Narrow Security Latch Guard:

  • Plate Height: 6"
  • Plate Width: 1-1/2"
  • Plate Thickness: 12 Gauge (.104")
  • Material: 304 Stainless Steel
  • Offset: 1/4" (.250")
  • Non-Handed (reversible)
  • Fasteners: 2 each 1/4-20 x 1-3/4" flat head machine screws and finishing washers.
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Don-Jo NLP-106-630 Security Plate Dimensions (PDF)

*Sold Individually.
